summary: Adds a 'Draft with GenAI' button to the incident tactical report dialog. It calls new GET /{organization}/incidents/{id}/report/tactical/generate (login required via the authenticated org router, plus IncidentEditPermission: org admin, commander or reporter), which pulls the incident's Slack channel messages, sends them to the project's AI plugin to draft Conditions/Actions/Needs, logs an 'AI-generated tactical report created' event on the incident, and fills the report form (with an AI disclaimer appended) for review before saving.

statements.why: The new address is behind get_current_user (api.py:260-261) and IncidentEditPermission; no secret, money-handling or data-loss problem. (It does send Slack channel contents to the configured AI provider; see misses.)

statements.text: + New server code that lists incidents and works without logging in. /{organization}/incidents/[incident_id]/report/tactical/generate
statements.why: It doesn't list incidents and it requires login: incident_router is mounted on authenticated_organization_api_router with Depends(get_current_user) (api.py:174-176, 260-261) and the route adds PermissionsDependency([IncidentEditPermission]) (incident/views.py:318-321). It generates an AI draft report from one incident's Slack channel and logs an event.

statements.text: The agent also changed src/dispatch/ai/enums.py, src/dispatch/ai/models.py and src/dispatch/ai/service.py, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: True but vacuous; ai/service.py holds the actual Slack-to-AI report generation.

misses.what: New 'Draft with GenAI' button in the tactical report dialog that auto-fills Conditions/Actions/Needs from the incident's Slack channel (overwrites what's typed, adds an AI disclaimer).
Incident Slack channel messages (sensitive security-incident content) are sent to the configured AI provider each time the button is used, which also costs AI usage per click.
Each generation records an 'AI-generated tactical report created' event (with the report text) on the incident timeline.
